definitions.gloss: lightning surge; power surge from lightning
definitions.explanation: A sudden spike in voltage that travels along power or phone lines when lightning strikes nearby, which can damage electrical appliances and computers.

examples.japanese: {雷|らい}サージ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧。
examples.english: My computer was damaged by a lightning surge.

examples.japanese: {雷|らい}サージ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電源|でんげん}タップ→電源タップ：07012_dengentappu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a power strip with lightning surge protection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雷|かみなり}→雷：02197_kaminari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{雷|らい}サージ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おこう。
examples.english: There are a lot of thunderstorms in summer, so let's get ready to protect our appliances from lightning surges.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
In this word {雷|らい} is read らい, as in ⟦{落雷|らくらい}→落雷：07379_rakurai⟧ and ⟦{雷雨|らいう}→雷雨：15922_raiu⟧; on its own the kanji is read かみなり (⟦{雷|かみなり}→雷：02197_kaminari⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雷|らい}サージ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: lightning surge protection
- {雷|らい}サージ⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦タップ→タップ：05395_tappu⟧: surge-protected power strip
- {雷|らい}サージ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{故障|こしょう}する→故障する：01826_koshousuru⟧: to break down from a lightning surge

RELATED WORDS:
- サージ: surge (of voltage)
- ⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧: power outage
- ⟦{落雷|らくらい}→落雷：07379_rakurai⟧: lightning strike
